title: Deferral Policies — Leadville Race Series (LT100 Run entry deferral, refund and cancellation terms)
claims: A race entry can be deferred only one time and only to the following year's event; all fees are non-refundable and registrations are not transferable.
To use a deferral the athlete must re-register during the designated deferral window and pay 100% of that year's published entry fee; the original registration fee is not refunded or transferred.
The LT100 Run deferral deadline was August 21, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. MST (start of expo); 2027 deferral registration runs November 1-15, 2026.

Deployed or recalled active-duty military may qualify for a refund or complimentary deferral with proof of orders; pregnant or postpartum participants may qualify with an authorized medical note; for an approved deferral the original paid entry fee transfers in full to the following year.
No refunds or changes are permitted for transactions more than 365 days old; add-ons, merchandise and donations are nonrefundable and final.

If Life Time cancels an event, registered participants may defer to the following year at no additional entry fee, or request a partial refund: 70% at 90 or more days out, 50% at 60-89 days, 40% at 30-59 days; service fees, merchandise and donations are nonrefundable.
